newsitem.title: CHINA: China offshore crude output to exceed 16 mln T.
newsitem.headline: China offshore crude output to exceed 16 mln T.

text.p: China's offshore crude oil output is expected to exceed 16 million tonnes in 1997, an official of China National Offshore Oil Co (CNOOC) said on Monday.
Offshore fields produced a record 15 million tonnes last year.
China is to develop eight offshore oil and natural gas fields in 1997, most of them in the northeastern Bohai and South China Sea areas, the official said.
China offshore crude oil output reached 15 million tonnes and offshore natural gas production topped 3 billion cubic metres last year.
